slides.body: Retail prices went from ₹6-7 to ₹7.50-8 per egg.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Traders cite tight supply, lower production and fewer birds in poultry farms; farmers also report higher feed costs.

captions.instagram:
Eggs hit ₹96 a dozen wholesale in Hyderabad

Wholesale egg prices in Hyderabad rose from about ₹80 to ₹96 a dozen within days, after holding steady since early August.

Why it matters: Traders cite tight supply, lower production and fewer birds in poultry farms; farmers also report higher feed costs.

Source: Siasat. Image: Siasat
